**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/07/30 (Sun) 14:19
- [USER] User inquired about the understanding of speech by people who hear for the first time after receiving hearing implants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] People who receive hearing implants for the first time may not initially understand what other people are saying.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It can take time for individuals to adjust to hearing sounds and speech again.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It may take some time for individuals to fully understand spoken language after receiving hearing implants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is not uncommon for people who receive hearing implants to need therapy and training to learn how to interpret the sounds they are hearing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Therapy and training can improve their ability to understand spoken language.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In some cases, individuals may be able to understand spoken language relatively quickly after receiving hearing implants.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In other cases, it may take longer for individuals to understand spoken language.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ability to understand spoken language can depend on the severity of the individual's hearing loss.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The duration of time the individual has gone without being able to hear can also affect their understanding of spoken language.
